# SCI-NOI v0.1 — Decision Log

Status: Stage A launch decisions applied; packet awaiting owner approval

Scientific owner: Grant Wilson

Launch date: `2026-08-29`

## Owner-Approved Launch Decisions

| Decision | Applied substance |
| --- | --- |
| `SCI-NOI-PROCESS-D001` | Launch SCI-NOI v0.1 as a recovery-first Stage A effort at high reasoning effort after completion of SCI-JINC. |
| `SCI-NOI-PROCESS-D002` | Use one SCI-NOI package with `NOI-GEN` realization generation and `NOI-UNC` empirical uncertainty inference, separated by a hard typed boundary. |
| `SCI-NOI-PROCESS-D003` | Add `NOI-STD` standardized signal as a separate method/product identity within SCI-NOI, not a separate package and not an uncertainty estimate. |
| `SCI-NOI-PROCESS-D004` | Limit an unvalidated `NOI-STD` claim to “standardized by the stated empirical scale,” not Gaussian significance or detection probability. |
| `SCI-NOI-PROCESS-D005` | Treat fixed-state and relearned generation as distinct possible methods that answer different questions; do not mix them or select a baseline in Stage A. |
| `SCI-NOI-PROCESS-D006` | Keep validity, MAP/PTC coefficients, assignments, realization QC, variance/covariance, empirical weights, and standardized signal separately typed. |
| `SCI-NOI-PROCESS-D007` | Prohibit automatic use of an empirical NOI weight as a MAP-facing PTC coefficient. |
| `SCI-NOI-PROCESS-D008` | Preserve MAP and JINC parents unchanged; attach NOI results as exact versioned companions. |
| `SCI-NOI-PROCESS-D009` | Permit honest diagonal, stationary/kernel, structured, ensemble, projected, full, or unavailable covariance states; do not mandate dense covariance. |
| `SCI-NOI-PROCESS-D010` | Make realization persistence plan-controlled; permit exact regeneration or streaming sufficient statistics with explicit audit limitations. |
| `SCI-NOI-PROCESS-D011` | Recover prior science, implementation, ambiguities, dependencies, and evidence classification before new drafting. |
| `SCI-NOI-PROCESS-D012` | Stop after Stage A owner review and the first owner question; do not begin Stage B, implementation, or frozen MAP/JINC/PTC modification. |

## Owner Walkthrough Decisions After Closure

| Decision | Applied substance |
| --- | --- |
| `SCI-NOI-ODQ-102A` | Select `NOI-GEN/PTC-TO-FROZEN-MAP-CONDITIONAL-SIGN@1` as the ordinary route. Apply the NOI-owned assignment modifier at the exact PTC-to-MAP numerical boundary; MAP may consume it inline during frozen accumulation and no randomized-timestream materialization is required. NOI owns design and realization identity/product; MAP owns conforming application only. The output is an NOI realization map, not ordinary MAP science. Existing coefficient and numerical `coverage_cut` gates remain unavailable. |
| `SCI-NOI-ODQ-102B` | Define one ordinary coherence unit as one stable realized detector/channel within one observation. Once assigned for a member, its modifier applies to every admitted sample of that detector throughout the observation; sample/scan/subscan/chunk/order boundaries do not change it. Sign law and finite design remain ODQ-102C. |
| `SCI-NOI-ODQ-102C` | Select network-stratified coefficient-balanced randomized detector signs for the ordinary route. Derive detector coefficient mass from exact frozen MAP-admitted positive contributions and balance separately inside each stable readout network; no network/array/observation may balance another. Require complement-symmetric admission/probability with detector marginal `1/2`; do not require detector-count balance. Keep the design coefficient distinct from precision, empirical NOI weight, exposure, validity, and the PTC-owned MAP coefficient. Exact finite mechanics remain ODQ-102D. |
| `SCI-NOI-ODQ-102D` | Delegate exact finite-design selection and justification to the implementation-blind scientific-contract author. Preserve the tolerance-conditioned construction only as a nonbinding suggestion that the author may adopt, revise, or reject within ODQ-102A/B/C. Require complete exact mechanics/rationale or one precise returned question; no numerical availability or advance owner acceptance follows. |
| `SCI-NOI-ODQ-104` | Require every GEN method to classify every scientifically consequential adjacent reduction state as fixed, rerun/relearned, not applicable, or unavailable. A relearned method identifies consequential rerun/relearned stages and resulting state that may differ from the real reduction; generic or partial labels are insufficient. This defines the scientific method and does not require exhaustive implementation provenance. |
| `SCI-NOI-ODQ-103` | Approve the scientific claim boundary that randomization intends to suppress source signal but does not by construction alone establish source-free maps. Retain exact source-content, target, assumption, residual, leakage, and prohibited-claim disclosures. Delegate clearer exact terminology to the Stage-B scientific author; the provisional long label is nonbinding. |
| `SCI-NOI-ODQ-105A` | Fail GEN closed for every UNC use if any admitted realization fails or does not complete through the declared frozen operator. Rejected finite-design candidates are search outcomes, not failures or members. Do not reinterpret completed survivors as a partial ensemble. Require diagnostically sufficient cause/context without exhaustive implementation provenance. |
| `SCI-NOI-ODQ-105B` | Authorize the zero-centered conditional detector-sign-randomization second moment `V_hat_cond(p)=sum_b omega_b M_b(p)^2` with exact normalized finite-design weights on the common all-member valid finite domain. Do not subtract the finite ensemble mean or apply `B-1`; report dependence, rank, effective information, and estimator uncertainty/unavailability; make no physical-noise, MAP-covariance, or independent-observation claim. |
| `SCI-NOI-ODQ-106` | Treat the ODQ-105B pointwise conditional second moment as the ordinary primary representation, not as covariance by shape. Permit retained ensembles and separately identified projected, stationary/kernel, structured, or full covariance methods without universally requiring dense covariance. Require exact estimator/member/domain/rank/null/regularization/omission disclosures; unknown or unreported covariance is not zero or independence; no survivor/missing-member rescue and no inverse or precision implication. |
